summary: Southwestern Public Service Company (SPS) filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $650M in 5.300% First Mortgage Bonds due 2036 and $550M in 5.875% First Mortgage Bonds due 2056, totaling $1.2B. The bonds were sold via underwriters BMO Capital Markets, BofA Securities, Morgan Stanley, RBC Capital Markets, and Wells Fargo Securities under an existing Form S-3 shelf registration. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes; no acquisition or special situation is involved. This is a routine debt offering by a regulated utility, not a special situation. Watch for ongoing debt management or refinancing updates.
